title: Session authenticity, identifier generation and logout invalidation need evidence
remediation: Component maintainers and deployment identity operators inventory assessed communications sessions and identifier issuers. Review authenticity and approved randomness requirements. Use exact-release test results and controlled deployment observations for distinct system-generated identifiers, rejection of unrecognized identifiers, and denial after logout or termination. G3 contributes only its scoped relay ingress evidence.

milestones.title: Collect the assessed session map and release and deployment verification of session authenticity, identifier issuance and invalidation
